newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan rupee ends up in kerb in dull trade.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan rupee ends up in kerb in dull trade.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee closed 0.20 up at 41.85 to the dollar in the kerb market on Sunday amid a dull trade and high supply of the U.S. currency, dealers said.
They said the rupee was likely to open stable on Monday on lack of trading interest by major players because of the year-end holiday season.

The State (central) Bank of Pakistan rate, last changed on October 22, was 40.1200/40.3206 to the dollar. The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates closed at 4.80 percent compared to Saturday's 5.0 percent. - Ovais Subhani 9221-5685192
